### An Answered Prayer
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/answered-prayer
Passage: Psalm 116:1–9
Points:
- God graciously provides His people with tangible reasons to love Him by answering their cries for mercy.
- Facing severe afflictions beyond human remedy highlights our total dependence on the Lord.
- Calling upon God in prayer allows believers to witness His deliverance firsthand.
- Experiencing God's faithfulness strengthens our gratitude, calms our doubts, and deepens our love for Him.

### A Song of Deliverance - Today's Insight - July 9, 2018
Author: Charles R. Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/a-song-of-deliverance-today-s-insight-july-9-2018.html
Passage: Psalm 116:7–13
Points:
- God provides completely and thoroughly for His children even amidst heavy grief.
- Remembering the Lord's bountiful dealings allows a troubled soul to return to rest.
- Experiencing abundant grace moves believers to ask how to show proper gratitude.
- Lifting the cup of salvation means publicly declaring God as our faithful Deliverer.
- Proclaiming God's benefits openly to others helps believers rise above sorrow.
